result.evidence_B: About 150 words, near the overshoot limit. It miscounts "four new" channels, since PC is the existing baseline. Its tone is informal ("you lose", "you will still need"). result.comparative_reason: A is more precise and more faithful in describing the method and findings, and it keeps a proper abstract register. B miscounts the new channels, overstates the diamond norm, and is informal and less specific.
